analysis.buttonHint: Session charts from the official timing: race trace, lap-by-lap pace and tyres
analysis.title: Lap analysis
analysis.noSpoilersHint: On: the charts only use data up to the player's current time. Turn it off to see the whole session.
analysis.legend: Drivers: show or hide their series
analysis.noLaps: No data: this session has no timed laps.
analysis.nothingYet: No data up to this moment yet. Move the player forward or turn off «No spoilers».
analysis.identify: Each dot is a lap; on their representative laps, the second driver of each team uses squares instead of circles. Each driver's code sits next to their last dot when it fits (otherwise the legend names it); with a triangle, that dot is off the scale.
analysis.identifyLap: Each series carries its driver's code in the right margin, level with its last value or right next to it (with a short line to that height); when it doesn't fit, the legend names it. The second driver of each team is dashed. With a triangle, the last value is off the scale. A series ending in a bar belongs to a car that stopped crossing the line (the leader has done three laps since its last crossing): the legend says up to which lap it goes.

raceTrace.chart: Race trace: gap to the leader at each line crossing, lap by lap
raceTrace.axis: Gap to the leader at the line (s), per lap
raceTrace.basis: Difference between the official line-crossing times of each lap, with no fuel correction or smoothing. The leader of each lap is at the top. A lapped car can be more than a lap behind; a car that stops crossing the line ends its series.
raceTrace.onlyRace: The race trace only makes sense in races and sprints: in practice and qualifying every driver runs on their own and there is no on-track gap to compare lap by lap. See «Pace» or «Tyres».

pace.chartLap: Pace: official time of each lap, per lap
pace.chartTime: Pace: official time of each lap, by the session time when it ends
pace.basis: Official lap times, with no fuel correction or smoothing. Laps that are not useful to compare pace are marked, not removed.
pace.markExcluded: ○ excluded: pit, SC, VSC, red flag or lap 1
pace.noTime: No official time: {n} lap (not drawn) | No official time: {n} laps (not drawn)
pace.lap1: Lap 1: no official time (start from the grid).
pace.noTrackStatus: No per-lap track status: laps under SC, VSC or red flag cannot be marked.
pace.outside: {n} lap is outside the pace scale. | {n} laps are outside the pace scale.
pace.nothingShown: Pick a driver in the legend to see their pace.

stints.label: Tyre stints per driver
stints.basisRace: One stint per set of tyres according to the timing, from its first to its last lap. Press one to go to its start.
stints.basisRuns: One stint per run on track according to the timing, from pit exit to pit entry. Press one to go to its start.
stints.tyreLifeHint: Laps on the tyre set according to the timing (TyreLife). A used set can carry laps from other sessions (practice or qualifying), so it is not the age in this session.
